author: Look what I found
text: Absolutely fantastic…. I ordered through Uber Eats as I fancied trying somewhere new, and I’m so glad I did. The food arrived hot, fresh and packed with flavour!! easily some of the best Caribbean food I’ve had. I enjoyed it so much that I actually rang the restaurant afterwards. I think they were expecting a complaint, but I just wanted to tell them how impressed I was and how much I’d enjoyed the food. People are often quick to complain when something isn’t right,, but I think it’s just as important to let businesses know when they’ve done an outstanding job.I’ll definitely be ordering again and can’t wait to visit in person. Highly recommended!
